verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I waited patiently upon the Lord
And He inclined and heard my cry
He pulled me up out of the miry clay
He set my feet upon the Rock

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
He gave me beauty for ashes
And joy for my mourning
And praise for heaviness
He put a new song in my mouth and a
Crown upon my head
He gave me life forevermore

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
He's been
So good, so, so good to me
So good, so, so good to me
So good, so, so good to me, Jesus

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
He picked me up and He turned me around
And He placed my feet on the solid ground
Hallelujah, hallelujah

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
Now I've got
Love, joy, peace and righteousness
In the Holy Spirit

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
Let us become more aware of Your presence
Let us experience the glory of your goodness

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
I lift my eyes up from my circumstances
I lift my eyes to You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I wanna be like Mary
I wanna see what she saw
I wanna choose the best thing
To sit here at Your feet

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I wanna be like David
I wanna see what he saw
I wanna choose the best thing
To sit here at Your feet
